player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''BartmanMLV''') posted a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list on DeckTech in October 1999.
description: A deck for those with the resources, a drop & drain deck with no-brainer counters  It luckily helped me win a tournament in Dagobah 10/2/99
cards: posted: Cloud City Port Town District
Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith
A Bright Center To The Universe
posted: A Bright Center to the Universe (SE)
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Total 60 as published (header counts match). Coruscant is marked '(SL)'; the starting Effect is one of Security Precautions, A Bright Center To The Universe or Den Of Thieves depending on the opponent, so no starting Effect is set.

'(SE)' after A Bright Center To The Universe, Den Of Thieves and Security Precautions marks the Special Edition cards, not virtual cards; 'Twilek Advisor (SI)' dested the Special Edition Twi'lek Advisor.

Posted 'DVDLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'EPP Vader' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; '5D6RA7' 5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix); 'Wounded Wookie' Wounded Wookiee; 'Abyssan Ornament' Abyssin Ornament; 'Mist Hunter' and 'Punishing One' the Dagobah starships (posted without pilots).
Tournament win 'in Dagobah 10/2/99' names no event, so the deck is filed as general.
player_note: The description says the deck 'luckily helped me win a tournament in Dagobah 10/2/99' (event not otherwise named).
